For a generated numerator of degree d=a+b−1, the script forms, for each integer 0≤r≤d,

\[
T_r(t)=\sum_{k=0}^{d-r} A_{k,d-r-k}t^k,

\]

Thus r is the exponent of the omitted homogeneous variable w. The script attempts exact division by `(1+t)^m_r` and tests the resulting coefficient list. No variable-dependent coefficient normalization is performed.

The exponent is a prescribed nonnegative integer. It is **not** a measurement of the largest possible power dividing the diagonal polynomial. For r=2 it agrees with a+b−5 when that number is nonnegative. For 2r≥d there is no division, so the residual is the original diagonal polynomial. These cases remain in the scan.

The intended universal residual claim should include existence of an integer-polynomial quotient Q satisfying `T_r=(1+t)^m_r Q`, followed by its coefficient properties. A theorem merely conditional on divisibility would be weaker than the experimentally tested combined claim. The current prose's “after exact removal” presupposes this existence; it is not yet a formal definition.

The division code is mathematically exact: for ascending coefficients c₀,…,cₙ, it constructs q₀=c₀ and qₖ=cₖ−qₖ₋₁, then checks cₙ=qₙ₋₁. That is the coefficient identity for multiplication by 1+t. The lists retain leading, trailing and internal zeros. Zero diagonals are included and remain zero after division. The original list length and the bound on m prevent requesting division of a list with fewer than two positions. The checked quotient model has generators

    A = [[1,1],[u,u+v]], B = [[1+v,1],[u,u]].

An upper-right product entry counts weighted two-state walks from state 0 to
state 1. For an A letter, allowed edge weights are 0->0:1, 0->1:1,
1->0:u, 1->1:u or v. For a B letter they are 0->0:1 or v,

formal bijection with a pre-existing named combinatorial family is claimed.

namespace MathGKM.Markov

def PolyNonneg16 (P : BiPoly) : Prop := ∀ i j, 0 ≤ coeff P i j
theorem poly_add_nonneg16 {P Q : BiPoly} (hp : PolyNonneg16 P)
    (hq : PolyNonneg16 Q) : PolyNonneg16 (P+Q) := by
  intro i j
  exact add_nonneg (hp i j) (hq i j)
theorem poly_mul_nonneg16 {P Q : BiPoly} (hp : PolyNonneg16 P)
    (hq : PolyNonneg16 Q) : PolyNonneg16 (P*Q) := by
  intro i j
  simp only [coeff,Polynomial.coeff_mul,Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro ab hab
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro cd hcd
  exact mul_nonneg (hp ab.1 cd.1) (hq ab.2 cd.2)
theorem poly_one_nonneg16 : PolyNonneg16 1 := by
  intro i j
  by_cases hi : i=0 <;> by_cases hj : j=0 <;>
    simp [coeff,Polynomial.coeff_one,hi,hj]
theorem poly_U_nonneg16 : PolyNonneg16 U := by
  intro i j
  by_cases hi : 1=i <;> by_cases hj : j=0 <;>
    simp [coeff,U,Polynomial.coeff_X,Polynomial.coeff_one,hi,hj]
theorem poly_V_nonneg16 : PolyNonneg16 V := by
  intro i j
  by_cases hi : i=0 <;> by_cases hj : 1=j <;>
    simp [coeff,V,Polynomial.coeff_C,Polynomial.coeff_X,hi,hj]

def MatNonneg16 (m : Mat16 BiPoly) : Prop :=
  PolyNonneg16 m.a ∧ PolyNonneg16 m.b ∧ PolyNonneg16 m.c ∧ PolyNonneg16 m.d
theorem mat_mul_nonneg16 {x y : Mat16 BiPoly} (hx : MatNonneg16 x)
    (hy : MatNonneg16 y) : MatNonneg16 (mm16 x y) := by
  obtain ⟨xa,xb,xc,xd⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨ya,yb,yc,yd⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨poly_add_nonneg16 (poly_mul_nonneg16 xa ya) (poly_mul_nonneg16 xb yc),
    poly_add_nonneg16 (poly_mul_nonneg16 xa yb) (poly_mul_nonneg16 xb yd),
    poly_add_nonneg16 (poly_mul_nonneg16 xc ya) (poly_mul_nonneg16 xd yc),
    poly_add_nonneg16 (poly_mul_nonneg16 xc yb) (poly_mul_nonneg16 xd yd)⟩

theorem mat_pair_nonneg16 (path : List Bool) (xy : Mat16 BiPoly × Mat16 BiPoly)
    (hx : MatNonneg16 xy.1) (hy : MatNonneg16 xy.2) :
    let out := path.foldl matPairStep16 xy
    MatNonneg16 out.1 ∧ MatNonneg16 out.2 := by
  induction path generalizing xy with
  | nil => exact ⟨hx,hy⟩
  | cons r rs ih =>
    cases r
    · exact ih _ hx (mat_mul_nonneg16 hx hy)
    · exact ih _ (mat_mul_nonneg16 hx hy) hy

/-- Every coefficient of the explicit two-variable quotient is nonnegative. -/
theorem quotient_coeff_nonneg16 (path : List Bool) :
    PolyNonneg16 (qTree16 U V (1 : BiPoly) path).2.1 := by
  rw [quotient_matrix16]
  have hA : MatNonneg16 (matA16 U V) :=
    ⟨poly_one_nonneg16,poly_one_nonneg16,poly_U_nonneg16,
      poly_add_nonneg16 poly_U_nonneg16 poly_V_nonneg16⟩
  have hB : MatNonneg16 (matB16 U V) :=
    ⟨poly_add_nonneg16 poly_one_nonneg16 poly_V_nonneg16,
      poly_one_nonneg16,poly_U_nonneg16,poly_U_nonneg16⟩
  have h := mat_pair_nonneg16 path (matA16 U V,matB16 U V) hA hB
  exact (mat_mul_nonneg16 h.1 h.2).2.1

namespace MathGKM.Markov
noncomputable section

@[ext] structure Mat16 (R : Type*) where
  a : R
  b : R
  c : R
  d : R

def mm16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x y : Mat16 R) : Mat16 R :=
  ⟨x.a*y.a+x.b*y.c, x.a*y.b+x.b*y.d,
   x.c*y.a+x.d*y.c, x.c*y.b+x.d*y.d⟩
def tr16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x : Mat16 R) := x.a+x.d
def det16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x : Mat16 R) := x.a*x.d-x.b*x.c

theorem mm_assoc16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x y z : Mat16 R) :
    mm16 (mm16 x y) z = mm16 x (mm16 y z) := by
  ext <;> simp [mm16] <;> ring
theorem det_mul16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x y : Mat16 R) :
    det16 (mm16 x y) = det16 x * det16 y := by simp [det16,mm16]; ring
theorem ch_left16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x y : Mat16 R) :
    (mm16 x (mm16 x y)).b = tr16 x*(mm16 x y).b-det16 x*y.b ∧
    tr16 (mm16 x (mm16 x y)) = tr16 x*tr16 (mm16 x y)-det16 x*tr16 y := by
  constructor <;> simp [mm16,tr16,det16] <;> ring
theorem ch_right16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x y : Mat16 R) :
    (mm16 (mm16 x y) y).b = tr16 y*(mm16 x y).b-det16 y*x.b ∧
    tr16 (mm16 (mm16 x y) y) = tr16 y*tr16 (mm16 x y)-det16 y*tr16 x := by
  constructor <;> simp [mm16,tr16,det16] <;> ring

def matA16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u v : R) : Mat16 R := ⟨1,1,u,u+v⟩
def matB16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u v : R) : Mat16 R := ⟨1+v,1,u,u⟩
def matPairStep16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (xy : Mat16 R × Mat16 R)
    (r : Bool) : Mat16 R × Mat16 R :=
  if r then (mm16 xy.1 xy.2,xy.2) else (xy.1,mm16 xy.1 xy.2)
def matTops16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (xy : Mat16 R × Mat16 R) : QTriple16 R :=
  (xy.1.b,(mm16 xy.1 xy.2).b,xy.2.b)
def MatValid16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u v : R) (f : Frame)
    (x y : Mat16 R) : Prop :=
  det16 x=u^f.lo.a*v^f.lo.b ∧ det16 y=u^f.hi.a*v^f.hi.b ∧
  tr16 x=(1+u+v)*x.b ∧ tr16 y=(1+u+v)*y.b ∧
  tr16 (mm16 x y)=(1+u+v)*(mm16 x y).b

theorem mat_initial16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u v : R) :
    MatValid16 u v initial (matA16 u v) (matB16 u v) := by
  simp [MatValid16,initial,matA16,matB16,det16,tr16,mm16] <;> ring_nf <;> simp

theorem mat_valid_step16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u v : R)
    {f : Frame} {x y : Mat16 R} (hi : FrameIndices f)
    (h : MatValid16 u v f x y) (r : Bool) :
    MatValid16 u v (advance f r)
      (matPairStep16 (x,y) r).1 (matPairStep16 (x,y) r).2 := by
  obtain ⟨dx,dy,tx,ty,tm⟩ := h
  have dm : det16 (mm16 x y) = u^f.mid.a*v^f.mid.b := by
    rw [det_mul16,dx,dy,hi.1,hi.2.1,pow_add,pow_add]
    ring
  cases r
  · refine ⟨dx,dm,tx,tm,?_⟩
    change tr16 (mm16 x (mm16 x y)) = (1+u+v)*(mm16 x (mm16 x y)).b
    rw [(ch_left16 x y).2, (ch_left16 x y).1, tx,ty,tm]
    ring
  · refine ⟨dm,dy,tm,ty,?_⟩
    change tr16 (mm16 (mm16 x y) y) = (1+u+v)*(mm16 (mm16 x y) y).b
    rw [(ch_right16 x y).2, (ch_right16 x y).1, tx,ty,tm]
    ring

theorem mat_tops_step16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u v : R)
    {f : Frame} {x y : Mat16 R} (h : MatValid16 u v f x y) (r : Bool) :
    qAdvance16 u v 1 f (matTops16 (x,y)) r =
      matTops16 (matPairStep16 (x,y) r) := by
  obtain ⟨dx,dy,tx,ty,tm⟩ := h
  cases r <;> simp only [qAdvance16,matTops16,matPairStep16,
    Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,if_true,one_pow,mul_one]
  · rw [(ch_left16 x y).1,tx,dx]
    congr 2 <;> ring
  · rw [(ch_right16 x y).1,ty,dy]
    congr 2 <;> ring

theorem mat_fold16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u v : R) (path : List Bool)
    (f : Frame) (xy : Mat16 R × Mat16 R) (hi : FrameIndices f)
    (h : MatValid16 u v f xy.1 xy.2) :
    (path.foldl (qPairStep16 u v 1) (f,matTops16 xy)).2 =
      matTops16 (path.foldl matPairStep16 xy) := by
  induction path generalizing f xy with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons r rs ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons,qPairStep16]
    rw [mat_tops_step16 u v h r]
    exact ih _ _ (indices_advance hi r) (mat_valid_step16 u v hi h r)

theorem quotient_matrix16 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u v : R) (path : List Bool) :
    qTree16 u v 1 path =
      matTops16 (path.foldl matPairStep16 (matA16 u v,matB16 u v)) := by

    indices_initial (mat_initial16 u v)
  simpa [qTree16,matTops16,matA16,matB16,mm16] using h

#print axioms quotient_matrix16
end

theorem evalTri_natural_de6 {R A : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]

    · intro q

/-- Cross inequalities include ordinary adjacent log-concavity, and keep zeros. -/
def CrossLC (f : ℤ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i ≤ j → f i * f (j+1) ≤ f (i+1) * f j

def Smooth (f : ℤ → ℝ) (k : ℤ) : ℝ := f k + f (k-1)

theorem crossLC_shift {f : ℤ → ℝ} (h : CrossLC f) (s : ℤ) :
    CrossLC (fun k => f (k+s)) := by
  intro i j hij
  simpa [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using h (i+s) (j+s) (by omega)

theorem crossLC_forward {f : ℤ → ℝ} (h : CrossLC f) :
    CrossLC (fun k => f k + f (k+1)) := by
  intro i j hij
  by_cases he : i = j
  · subst j; simp [mul_comm]
  have h1 := h i j hij
  have h2 := h (i+1) (j+1) (by omega)
  have h3 := h i (j+1) (by omega)
  have h4 := h (i+1) j (by omega)
  dsimp only
  nlinarith

theorem crossLC_smooth {f : ℤ → ℝ} (h : CrossLC f) : CrossLC (Smooth f) := by
  have hs := crossLC_shift (crossLC_forward h) (-1)
  simpa [CrossLC, Smooth, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hs

def Pascal : ℕ → (ℤ → ℝ) → (ℤ → ℝ)
  | 0, f => f
  | n+1, f => Smooth (Pascal n f)

theorem crossLC_pascal {f : ℤ → ℝ} (h : CrossLC f) (n : ℕ) :
    CrossLC (Pascal n f) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ n ih => exact crossLC_smooth ih

theorem crossLC_adjacent {f : ℤ → ℝ} (h : CrossLC f) (k : ℤ) :
    f (k-1) * f (k+1) ≤ f k ^ 2 := by
  simpa [sq] using h (k-1) k (by omega)

def QuadSeq (A B C : ℝ) (k : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  if k=0 then A else if k=1 then B else if k=2 then C else 0

theorem quad_nonneg {A B C : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (k : ℤ) : 0 ≤ QuadSeq A B C k := by
  unfold QuadSeq; split_ifs <;> first | assumption | exact le_rfl

theorem crossLC_quad {A B C : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (h : A*C ≤ B^2) : CrossLC (QuadSeq A B C) := by
  intro i j hij
  by_cases hi : 0 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 2
  · by_cases hj : -1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ 1
    · obtain ⟨hi0,hi2⟩ := hi
      obtain ⟨hj0,hj1⟩ := hj
      interval_cases i <;> interval_cases j <;> norm_num [QuadSeq] at * <;> nlinarith
    · have hz : QuadSeq A B C (j+1) = 0 := by
        simp only [QuadSeq]; split_ifs <;> first | omega | rfl
      rw [hz, mul_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (quad_nonneg hA hB hC _) (quad_nonneg hA hB hC _)
  · have hz : QuadSeq A B C i = 0 := by
      simp only [QuadSeq]; split_ifs <;> first | omega | rfl
    rw [hz, zero_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg (quad_nonneg hA hB hC _) (quad_nonneg hA hB hC _)

theorem quadratic_pascal_logConcave {A B C : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (h : A*C ≤ B^2) (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    Pascal n (QuadSeq A B C) (k-1) * Pascal n (QuadSeq A B C) (k+1) ≤
      Pascal n (QuadSeq A B C) k ^ 2 :=
  crossLC_adjacent (crossLC_pascal (crossLC_quad hA hB hC h) n) k

open Polynomial

/-- Polynomial coefficients extended by zero at negative integer indices. -/
def CoeffSeq (p : ℝ[X]) (k : ℤ) : ℝ := if k < 0 then 0 else p.coeff k.toNat

theorem coeffSeq_smooth (p : ℝ[X]) :
    CoeffSeq ((1+X)*p) = Smooth (CoeffSeq p) := by
  funext k
  by_cases hk : k < 0
  · have hk' : k-1 < 0 := by omega

def Quadratic (A B D : ℝ) : ℝ[X] := C A + C B * X + C D * X^2

    (hD : 0 ≤ D) (h : A*D ≤ B^2) (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    let f := CoeffSeq ((1+X)^n * Quadratic A B D)
